description: This file defines functions and constants related to reverse indexing of pack files in a version control system (likely Git). It provides structures, macros, and function prototypes for loading, verifying, and translating between different object position representations within pack and multi-pack index files.

methods.name: load_pack_revindex
methods.description: Populates the reverse index data structures for a given pack.
methods.load_pack_revindex_from_disk: Loads a pack's reverse index directly from disk.
methods.verify_pack_revindex: Verifies that the on-disk reverse index matches what would be generated from scratch.
methods.load_midx_revindex: Loads the reverse index for a multi-pack index.
methods.close_midx_revindex: Frees resources associated with a multi-pack reverse index.
methods.offset_to_pack_pos: Converts an object offset to a pack position, loading the reverse index if necessary.
methods.pack_pos_to_index: Converts a pack-relative position to an index-relative position.
methods.pack_pos_to_offset: Converts a pack-relative position to byte offset within the pack.
methods.pack_pos_to_midx: Converts a pack-relative position to a multi-pack index position.
methods.midx_to_pack_pos: Converts a multi-pack index position to a pack position.
methods.midx_pair_to_pack_pos: Converts a pack ID and offset pair to a pack position.
